name: SilverCloud by Amwell
short_description: Evidence-based digital mental health platform offering CBT programs for depression, anxiety, insomnia, and stress. Acquired by Amwell for $320M. 30+ clinical studies and 1M+ users globally.
long_description: SilverCloud by Amwell is a leading digital mental health platform delivering evidence-based cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT) programs for depression, anxiety, insomnia, stress, and other conditions. Originally founded in Dublin, Ireland, SilverCloud was acquired by Amwell in 2021 for $320 million. The platform offers both self-guided and coach-supported programs, with over 30 clinical studies demonstrating significant clinical outcomes. SilverCloud programs integrate PHQ-9 and GAD-7 assessments for routine outcome measurement, with average engagement of 5+ modules completed per user. The Space from Depression and Space from Anxiety programs show 50%+ clinical improvement rates. SilverCloud serves over 1 million users globally through employer wellness programs, health plans, health systems, and university counseling centers. The platform is integrated into Amwell's broader virtual care ecosystem.
one_liner: Digital CBT platform for depression, anxiety, and insomnia with 30+ clinical studies.
best_for: Employers seeking evidence-based digital mental health for employees
Health plans implementing scalable behavioral health solutions
Health systems integrating digital therapeutics with telehealth
University counseling centers expanding access to mental health support
not_for: Organizations seeking standalone MBC assessment tools

pricing.notes: Enterprise pricing through Amwell. Typically sold to employers, health plans, and health systems. Contact Amwell for custom quote.

faqs.a: SilverCloud Health was acquired by Amwell in September 2021 for $320 million. The platform continues to operate as SilverCloud by Amwell, integrated into Amwell's virtual care ecosystem.
SilverCloud offers evidence-based CBT programs for depression, anxiety, generalized anxiety disorder, insomnia, and stress. Programs are available self-guided or with coach support.
Yes, SilverCloud has over 30 clinical studies including peer-reviewed RCTs demonstrating 50%+ reliable clinical improvement in depression and anxiety symptoms.
SilverCloud is sold through enterprise contracts to employers, health plans, and health systems. Pricing is typically PEPM (Per Employee Per Month) or population-based licensing through Amwell.
